**In this Staff Software Engineering role, you’ll be…

**

• Responsible for the full product development end-to-end.

• A technical lighthouse, defining architecture and coordinating with other engineers to move how we do engineering forward.

• Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape the solution to the problem and oversee technical implementations from end to end.

• A leader and mentor without direct people management. Continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are in your DNA, as you challenge the status quo, iterate, and learn from mistakes to build creative business solutions.

**Who is the Marketplace Team?

**The Marketplace Team works on our critical strategic mission to build the best solutions by partnering with leading consultants in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC).

Our partner platform, or marketplace as we call it, allows partners to use, build, and customise needed solutions for their clients.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision of becoming the leading GRC platform that helps organisations do the right thing to keep society safe, fair, and functional.

****Our tech stack:

• PHP with Laravel

• Angular 22

• TailwindCSS

• PostgreSQL

• Redis for caching

• Claude Code

• Serverless infrastructure on AWS

****What you’ll bring:

• Expert knowledge in at least one layer of our technical stack (we work with PHP and Angular), as well as general software architecture and system design.

• Demonstrated senior experience in a Software Engineering role, designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable systems in production, end-to-end.

• Experience in product development with a focus on quality and value delivery.

• The ability to define technical direction for systems clearly and lead actively in deep architectural and software design sessions.

• Good engineering practices for testing, deployment, & observability paired with the ability to communicate strategic trade-offs clearly, mentor senior colleagues, and increase impact across the organisation.

• The ability to raise the bar for engineering quality and performance through reference implementations and by defining ever-evolving code standards.

****We offer you:

• A starting salary of 79,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 89,000 DKK per month.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa support if needed.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

****Our recruitment process:

• 
Send your application and upload relevant information.

• 
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.

• 
30-minute online interview with the Hiring Manager.

• 
Completion of Personality Assessment & 1h Technical Assessment.

• 
A collaborative no-coding session where we work through building a real feature in Formalize: clarifying requirements, data modelling, and walking through pseudo-code together

• 
60-minute in-person interview to meet the team and a walkthrough of our career framework and offer details.

****About Formalize:

****Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, and Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began in the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, which laid the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We interview on an ongoing basis and hire when the right person is found.

For more information or questions, please contact the listed recruiter at the bottom of the job page. Otherwise, apply with your resume and relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to your application!

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are driving the transition toward more sustainable and energy-efficient solutions. As our Global Inventory Manager (m/f/d), you will ensure the right products are available at the right time across our global network, balancing customer service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

Working within a global supply chain organization, you will take ownership of inventory strategy and performance across regions and sites. Through data-driven decision-making, process standardization, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help optimize inventory, support business growth, and strengthen supply chain performance.

As part of a business experiencing significant global expansion, you will have the opportunity to shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and make a visible impact on our customers and our business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and drive the global inventory strategy, performance management, and inventory optimization agenda across regions and sites.

• Monitor inventory performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement actions that balance service levels, inventory investment, and cost.

• Standardize inventory processes, develop data-driven reporting, and lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen global supply chain performance.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools and dashboards (Excel, Power BI) to support data-driven decision-making and inventory optimization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in inventory management within a multinational, multi-site manufacturing or supply chain environment.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive results in a global matrix organization.

• Strong analytical and business acumen, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

• Experience working with S&OP/SIOP planning processes; knowledge of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is an advantage.

• A proactive, structured, and self-driven approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing and evolving global environment.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Some of the most critical applications in Danish banking run on technology that predates modern engineering practices. In the Reduce Legacy Tribe, you will help change that — applying AI, automation and thoughtful architecture to make modernisation faster, safer and repeatable. This is engineering work with real consequences, and you will see the results.

What you will be doing

You will join a collaborative squad working across teams to modernise business-critical web applications serving advisors, business customers and private customers. This is a practical software architecture role, not an Enterprise Architecture position.

You will analyse codebases, design migration patterns and develop reusable tooling with engineers, translating technical understanding into architecture decisions that guide day-to-day work. Working closely with development and delivery teams, you will shape solutions, discuss trade-offs and resolve implementation questions to make migration approaches workable.

Development teams retain ownership of implementation and delivery; your role is to help them turn complex modernisation challenges into practical solutions.

More specifically, you will:

• Analyse legacy code, dependencies and business flows to choose realistic migration strategies

• Design gradual replacements and rebuild where direct migration would carry complexity forward

• Develop reusable migration patterns, transition designs and developer tooling with teams

• Explore AI agents for analysis, component generation, testing and migration verification

• Reduce lead time through automated quality checks and safer, smaller deployments

About you

• Practical software engineering background, for example as a software architect, lead engineer or senior software engineer

• Strong understanding of end-to-end application design, including frontends, APIs, security, testing and observability

• Ability to read and understand an existing codebase and assess when to migrate, simplify or rebuild

• Clear communicator who can summarise complex topics and discuss trade-offs with engineers

• Understanding of AI-assisted development: how to guide agents, assess generated code and validate results

Experience with legacy modernisation, reusable migration tooling or our stack (React, .NET BFF services, Kubernetes, mainframe integration and GitHub Actions) is a plus. Comparable technologies are equally relevant, and we value the perspective you bring from different environments.

What we offer you

You will work primarily from our Aarhus or Copenhagen office, with the flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. You will tackle difficult engineering problems with visible results on applications used by thousands of customers, working alongside engineers who are genuinely curious about what AI can do for modernisation.

There is real room to grow your architectural thinking and broaden your experience with emerging development practices.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you are ready to take on complex engineering challenges and help shape the path forward for critical banking applications, we would be glad to hear from you. Reach out to hiring manager Ole Bang Fredsø Weigelt at owei@danskebank.dk if you have any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 1 December 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Portchain

Portchain exists to make maritime shipping more predictable, efficient, and green. We help shipping companies and terminals coordinate around shared, trustworthy information to reduce delays, fuel consumption, and emissions.

Our products support some of the world’s largest shipping companies, with more than 200 terminals connected through the Portchain Network.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

You’ll build services, APIs, and integrations that power carrier and terminal workflows, berth planning, and new products. Working closely with Product, you’ll turn customer problems into simple, scalable solutions and own your work from design through production.

Our stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud, with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.

How we work

Product teams of four or more engineers, each supported by a dedicated Product Manager, but with overlap between teams when needed.

We care about craftsmanship: understandable code, trustworthy high quality data, thoughtful user experiences, and systems that remain reliable and maintainable. We balance that care with pragmatic decisions and still deploy 10+ per day.

Curiosity matters here. We ask questions, explore customer problems, challenge assumptions, and learn from each other and from mistakes without blame.

How we use AI

AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. We use it for exploration, implementation, review, and technical sparring, and share useful practices with the team. We move faster than any of our customers, but not at the expense of quality or engineering understanding of behavior.

The final judgment remains with the engineer. We expect you to understand, review, validate, and be able to defend the code and decisions you ship, while protecting customer and company data.

What we’re looking for

• Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous execution, error handling, and diagnosing production issues.

• Strong relational database skills: schema design, SQL, transactions, and query performance. We use PostgreSQL.

• Experience designing robust APIs and integrating systems with different data formats and reliability characteristics.

• Experience deploying and operating software on GCP, AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform. We use GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL etc.)

• Sound architectural judgment, pride in your craft, and the ability to turn loosely defined problems into pragmatic solutions.

• Curiosity about unfamiliar domains and technologies, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to end-to-end ownership.

Useful extras include

GCP/Cloud Run, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, complex data ingestion, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience, and breadth across languages or technical side projects.

What we offer

• Meaningful work with global economic and environmental impact.

• Influence over products, architecture, and ways of working.

• Experienced, curious, and supportive colleagues.

• Competitive compensation and pension.

• Flexible working hours in our Copenhagen office.

• Subsidized lunch, snacks, and drinks.

• A dedicated development budget and support for continued learning.

If the role sounds exciting and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

Scope and authority

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

AI architecture

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

Governance and regulation

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

Team leadership

• Line management for four architects: coaching, performance, career development, hiring.

• Establish ways of working — review process, documentation standards, quality gates — and hold the team to them.

• Represent architecture in leadership forums, steering committees and cross-functional planning.

• Keep architects hands-on and embedded with engineering teams; architecture produced at a distance from delivery does not land.

What You Will Have Done By Month 12

• A published and adopted standard for what is built on Databricks, with evidence of designs changed by it.

• A clear model for data product alignment and ownership, applied on live work rather than documented in isolation.

• An architecture review forum running to a predictable cadence, with a visible ADR record and a known path for challenging a decision.

• Approved agentic and ML reference patterns in use.

• At least one legacy component fully decommissioned, not just superseded.

• A development plan in place for each of the four architects, and any open roles filled.

Essential Experience

• 5+ years designing and delivering production data platform solutions at enterprise scale, hands-on.

• At least 2 years line-managing technical specialists, including performance management, career development and hiring.

• Has held a design approval or architecture governance mandate, including declining designs and making that decision hold.

• Has led a platform migration or a parallel-run estate through to legacy decommission.

• Deep working knowledge of Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) as a target architecture, plus enough Azure Synapse (star schemas, conformed models, dedicated pools) to govern what remains there, and pipeline orchestration with ADF or Databricks Workflows.

• Has designed source-aligned, domain-aligned and consumer-aligned data products, with a clear view of where distributed domain ownership beats a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) and where it does not.

• Has implemented or governed a domain ownership model — data mesh or similar — including the federated governance and stewardship that makes it work.

• Has architected agentic and ML systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation and guardrails; feature and model lifecycle, serving, and monitoring for drift.

• Has set architecture standards that others adopted — solution patterns, reference architectures and architecture decision records.

• Has implemented data quality frameworks, data contracts or computational governance in production.

• Holds an architectural position under delivery pressure, and judges well when to concede.

• Communicates architecture clearly to technical and business audiences, including solution designs, ADRs and data flow diagrams.

• Understanding of retail, manufacturing, finance or supply chain business processes and how data flows through a business.

Desirable

• Familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and enterprise AI governance.

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Would you like to join the Regulatory Report team in Reporting Solutions, responsible for several critical business solutions and reporting processes within Credit and Financial Risk? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Regulatory Reporting team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach (SA-CR) provided by NASDAQ (Axiom), Unlikeliness to Pay, ESG and other applications within Regulatory Reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms and does coding in COBOL, Java, SQL, and Python, and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

**

• Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients

• Maintain and develop systems, data, and platforms within the business area of Credit Risk

• Ensure stable operations through maintenance, housekeeping, and quality improvements

• Design and maintain end-to-end data processing flows for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach and other applications within the team

• Develop high-quality business solutions based on business requirements in close cooperation with key stakeholders internally in BEC and clients

• Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations

• Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement

**To succeed you will have:

**

• 5y+ work experience as Senior Software Engineer from Banking or financial IT

• Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark or banks under regulations from EBA

• Extensive experience in ETL tools (SQL, Python, and Java)

• Hands-on experience in writing and optimizing SQL

• Experience in gathering development requirements

• Knowledge of data modeling and data warehouse architecture

• Preferably, work experience with NASDAQs AXIOM Platform

• Strong collaboration and communication skills.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

**It’s nice-to-have:

**

• A relevant Master degree

• Experience in Git, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines

• Preferable experience with PowerCenter workflow development

• Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet our technical expert and your future manager: Show off your experience

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anna.Barcinska@BEC.dk

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you interested in sustainability, enjoy working with data, and want to turn reporting requirements into practical action? Join Flatpay and help build the foundations of our ESG work across multiple markets!

We’re looking for a curious, structured colleague who enjoys digging into details, connecting with people, and bringing order to complex information.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,500 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**What You'll Do

**You’ll coordinate ESG data collection and reporting across our markets, working with internal teams, suppliers, and external compliance partners. From reviewing supplier documentation to improving reporting processes, you’ll help ensure we have reliable information and clear ways of working as we grow.

This is a hands-on role with international exposure and room to develop. You’ll help shape Flatpay’s ESG function from the ground up, taking increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow.

• Coordinate ESG reporting across markets. Organize data collection, follow up on inputs, and support accurate, timely reporting, including CSRD-related work where applicable.

• Build a reliable data foundation. Review compliance reports, product documentation, and supplier data sheets; identify gaps; and source the information needed for reporting.

• Work across teams and borders. Collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, and external compliance partners to make reporting processes clear and manageable.

• Track relevant requirements. Help assess what developments in CSRD, the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), and local producer responsibility schemes mean for Flatpay.

• Coordinate producer responsibility reporting. Work with Dansk Producentansvar (DPA), equivalent organisations in other markets, and relevant compliance partners.

• Support practical sustainability initiatives. Contribute to improvements in reverse logistics, refurbishment, and how we manage products throughout their lifecycle.

• Help establish our ESG function. Build processes, improve data quality, and gradually become an internal point of contact for sustainability reporting and compliance questions.

**Who You Are

**

• An interest in ESG and sustainability, particularly the data and reporting behind them.

• An analytical mindset and confidence working with spreadsheets and structured data.

• A careful, organised approach: you spot inconsistencies, ask questions, and follow through.

• The ability to work with colleagues and suppliers to get the information you need.

• Curiosity about regulations and the ability to translate complex information into clear next steps.

• Strong communication skills in English and an interest in working across international markets.

Previous exposure to ESG reporting, sustainability, compliance, or data analysis is a plus. This could come from a full-time role, student position or involvement in relevant project. Familiarity with CSRD or producer responsibility is welcome, but you don’t need to arrive as an expert in every framework.

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical ESG experience across multiple markets and see the direct impact of your work. Your ideas will help shape our processes, strengthen our reporting, and inform how we approach sustainability as we scale.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

**The Impact You'll Make

**You will shape the future of sustainable, high‑performance data centers by designing the physical system architectures that make them efficient, reliable, and scalable. Your work will directly influence how energy, cooling, and hardware come together to support the world’s most demanding digital infrastructure.

At Danfoss, data center sustainability is not a promise—it’s a mission. As a Senior Innovation Engineer, Liquid Cooling Data Center you will help customers reduce energy consumption, improve thermal performance, and prepare for next‑generation, high‑density compute environments.

You will work at the intersection of innovation and real‑world impact, collaborating across engineering, product, and customer teams to turn advanced thermal concepts into practical, deployable solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Design end‑to‑end thermal system architectures for air‑ and liquid‑cooled data centers, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Translate customer and business needs into system designs that integrate cooling components, facility loops, and rack‑level solutions.

• Define system requirements and boundary conditions to enable accurate simulation, CFD analysis, and performance modeling.

• Collaborate across engineering, product, and customer teams to support new builds and retrofit projects from concept to implementation.

• Drive innovation in liquid cooling and thermal optimization, contributing to next‑generation platforms and protected intellectual property.

**What We're Looking For

**

• At least 5 years of experience designing thermal or liquid cooling systems for data centers or similarly complex energy systems.

• Strong system‑level mindset, with the ability to connect facility infrastructure, cooling distribution, and rack‑level solutions into cohesive designs.

• Solid foundation in thermal engineering, including heat transfer, flow dynamics, and overall system optimization.

• Clear communicator, able to explain complex designs through schematics, diagrams, and well‑structured technical documentation.

• Hands‑on experience with engineering and design tools, such as CAD platforms and thermal or CFD simulation environments, and willingness to global travel up to 20% of the time.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

Do you study International Shipping & Trade at Copenhagen Business School, and are you looking for an internship where you can set direction and create valuable impact? Join us to help shape the future of digital freight through innovative projects in a dynamic international company.

**Be part of the movement - and play your part

****Internship: Freight Digital Customer Journey

**In this role, you will support key initiatives within the transformation of the digital customer journey for our Global Freight Customer Service organisation at DFDS. Our ambition is clear: by 2030, we want to deliver a seamless, digital, and standardised set-up that makes it easy to be a customer and easy to interact with customers across all freight touchpoints.

To achieve this, our Customer Service transformation is built on three strategic pillars:

• Self-Service:

• Building a one-stop-shop where customers can book and track units throughout the entire journey and across transport modalities.

• Contact Center Platform:

• Creating an interaction platform that enables Customer Service teams to engage with customers efficiently when support is needed, supported by a knowledge base that enhances the overall customer experience.

• Control Tower:

• Developing our internal platform for managing customer bookings, providing Customer Service with a more seamless and standardised way of handling bookings and tracking units across the DFDS network.

As an intern, you will work across all three pillars, supporting and driving the planning, coordination, and delivery of transformation initiatives. You will gain exposure to business and technology stakeholders and help ensure that projects move forward efficiently while creating value for our Customer Service organisation and customers.

**Examples Of Responsibilities

**

• Lead and assist on projects in various areas along the customer journey to help drive digitisation and standardisation across the DFDS Ferry domain (e.g. standardising customer service and sales processes)

• Drive or assist with project planning, coordination, and follow-up on key initiatives depending on size of project

• Prepare presentations for key stakeholders at all levels of the organisation including the executive suite

• Manage stakeholders e.g. local DFDS offices, and help roll out digitalisation and standardisation initiatives by interacting with particularly local customer service teams

• Conduct end-to-end process explorations and ad-hoc analyses, incl. building business cases

• Helping track project progress, dependencies, risks, and actions across initiatives

• Support with implementations e.g. testing, plan change management activities and ensure solutions are properly adopted

You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale business transformation, digital product development, process improvement, and change management in an international organisation.

You will play an important supporting role in our Customer Service transformation by helping teams stay aligned, ensuring key activities are coordinated effectively, and contributing to the successful adoption of new digital solutions and ways of working across the organisation.

**About You

**Are you eager to deepen your knowledge in the field of digital freight, and do you have a strong work ethic and passion for learning? Then this internship is for you!

**Additionally, We Are Looking For You Who Have

**

• A positive and curious mindset, also in dynamic periods

• A desire to make an impact, share your ideas and learn from others

• You keep things on track and get the details right

• Good collaboration skills, excited to contribute to an international organisation with colleagues from diverse backgrounds

**Furthermore, You Are

**

• Studying BSc International Shipping & Trade at Copenhagen Business School, ready to intern from September 2027

• A natural problem solver, when working individually and in a team

• Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy in your work

• Proactive in identifying and understanding data sources and solutions to data collection

• Confident using Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Power BI or similar tools is a plus

• Curious about AI and eager to use it to solve real business problems

We believe the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

**We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. Our newly built headquarters in Copenhagen is a unique, modern workplace. Here, we enjoy our own game room, fitness & massage, cantina and café, and a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

You’ll get the opportunity to join our student community, where you can participate in social and professional activities, connecting with fellow students from various departments across the organisation.

We plan to welcome three interns from BSc International Shipping & Trade in 2027, one in Global Customer Service, one in Direct Procurement and one in Procurement Technology, Sustainability & Operations. This gives you a chance to join a cohort where you can share experiences, exchange ideas, and grow together.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

**If you think your personality, skills and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

For questions about the recruitment, contact metboes@dfds.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Your impact begins here

**As Advanced data analyst in CMC Pilots, you will turn manufacturing and supply chain data into faster, better-informed decisions. You will scope, build and maintain the analytics that help colleagues get the most out of our production facilities and execute their processes better. As production demands rise to deliver Novo’s clinical pipeline, your work helps CMC Pilots act with clarity and pace, to ensure Novo have the API and Drug Product to deliver our clinical trials on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You will bring a background in manufacturing, chemistry, business analytics, data science or a related field, and the confidence to take an idea from definition to a working tool that people use.

• A Master’s degree. The field is flexible, for example engineering, business, IT, logistics or similar.

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, production or a similar operational environment.

• Experience scoping, developing and monitoring data and analytics solutions in production.

• Hands-on skills in Power BI or another BI tool, SQL and Python.

• A high level of data literacy and the ability to explain data value and requirements to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Experience working with and understanding complex enterprise architectures.

• A user-first mindset: you involve users early, work iteratively and check that business value is realised.

• Independence, ownership and drive, with strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

• Fluent English. Danish is not a requirement.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with BI or manufacturing intelligence in API or Drug Product processes. Broader production experience is also relevant.

• Databricks and PySpark, as the team expects to use them more.

• ETL/ELT pipeline development, data modelling, orchestration (Databricks Jobs, Apache Airflow or similar), GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.

• Experience with REST APIs and JSON, cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), and basic networking, security or Microsoft Entra ID concepts.

• Experience with manufacturing, time-series, MES, LIMS, DCS/SCADA or historian data, and with working in regulated GxP environments.

**What You’ll Do

**You will help CMC Pilots use data more and better to reach its operational and strategic goals. That means:

• Identify, scope, draft, develop and maintain data and analytics products for stakeholders in CMC Pilots.

• Help colleagues see where data can address their challenges and engage them in using it.

• Work with the central IT organisation on architecture, best practice and use cases.

• Communicate with key internal and external stakeholders, making decisions and keeping work moving.

• Support data analyst student assistants in their development and deliverables.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Data & Supply Chain team in CMC Pilots Business Support, part of CMC in Global Manufacturing & Supply. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products, scaling molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team has 15 professionals with varied cultural and educational backgrounds. They work on supply chain and production planning, business analytics and improvement projects, driven by exploration, process optimisation and solving complex business challenges. You will also partner with the central IT organisation and with stakeholders across CMC Pilots, and you will guide student assistants on the team.

Your main location is Bagsværd, in the Copenhagen area.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will own your work from first idea through implementation and validation and be trusted to take initiative. The team expects to use Databricks more, so there is room to build new skills as the data setup grows. You will learn from colleagues on the job, develop through relevant learning offerings, and be recognised for results.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DKK - 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to put data behind better decisions in pharmaceutical manufacturing, apply for the Advanced data analyst role by 1 December 2026. Please apply by submitting your CV including a brief motivation for applying.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
**Why Faculty?

**We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

**Why the Faculty Fellowship?

**Founded in 2014, Faculty is one of Europe’s leading applied AI companies. Faculty’s PhD-heavy team of deep AI experts has delivered hundreds of real-world AI products to improve critical public services and drive sustained economic returns across every sector of the economy. Widely recognised as a leader in AI safety, Faculty works for the world’s leading AI labs, such as OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic, to ensure their latest models are safe, human-led and explainable.

The Faculty Fellowship builds the AI talent engine for the world’s most ambitious organisations. It selects exceptional scientific minds and accelerates them into the top tier of AI practitioners. Past Fellows hold some of the most critical AI posts for organisations across every sector of the economy.

As part of our international expansion, we are bringing the Faculty Fellowship to Denmark through Halfspace (part of Faculty), a leading applied AI company in Copenhagen. Building on Faculty’s decade-long track record of developing exceptional AI talent and Halfspace’s expertise in delivering real-world AI solutions, the Fellowship will offer outstanding STEM talent in Denmark an opportunity to accelerate their careers in AI. As a Fellow, you will learn directly from leading AI practitioners before being embedded within an ambitious organisation, applying advanced AI and data science to solve complex commercial challenges and deliver meaningful impact.

**How It Works

**

• 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems.

• 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company.

• Demo Day Finale: Present your work to senior stakeholders and industry leaders, showcasing your technical capabilities and project impact.

Where our alumni go: our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like Physics X and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently.

**About The Role

**As a Fellow at Faculty, you will join an elite cohort transforming industries through cutting-edge data science. This intensive, eight week programme bridges academic and real world impact, embedding you directly into highs-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen and employer you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community.

**Who We're Looking For

**

• You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning.

• You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks.

• You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries.

• You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines.

• You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners.

• You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies.

**Requirements

**

• Right to work: We’re unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, so you’ll need to already have the right to work in Denmark. This includes citizens of EU/EEA countries and Switzerland, as well as anyone holding a valid Danish work permit or residence status. If your eligibility is based on a visa or permit, please include the details in your application so we can review your situation.

• Location & Logistics: This is a fully in-person, eight-week programme based in Copenhagen, Denmark so you will need to be able to commute daily for the entire duration. Please keep in mind that Faculty is unable to provide or reimburse accommodation and travel expenses.

**Our Timelines

**

• December 2026: Coding tests sent via email.

• January 2026: Interviewing starts - held remotely online.

• February 2027: Final notifications sent to all applicants.

• March 2027*: Programme starts.

• Please note that programme dates are tentative and may be adjusted if required. We will notify all applicants of any updates and changes as early as possible.

What the Fellowship offers

• Paid Experience: Fellows receive a competitive stipend/salary for the full eight-week duration of the programme.

• Expert-Led Training: Two weeks of immersive lectures followed by weekly Friday masterclasses, bridging the gap between academic theory and commercial data science.Dedicated Mentorship: Receive ongoing support and guidance from experienced Faculty practitioners, gaining insight into how AI and data science are applied to solve real-world business challenges while developing your technical, commercial and communication skills.

• Real-World Value: A dedicated six-week placement embedded with a business, tackling a high-stakes data science challenge.

• Career Launchpad: A proven pathway into industry, backed by a decade-long track record of launching exceptional individuals into top-tier AI careers.

• Unrivalled Networking: Connect with a 500+ strong alumni community and pitch your project to 100+ industry guests at Demo Day.

**Our Recruitment Ethos

**We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

_Are you ready to spark transformation and make an impact at a leading global brand? Look no further!

_As part of our Digital and Technology organisation, we are looking for a Programme Manager to lead the rollout projects of our SAP S/4HANA solution across our core value chain. You will join our Delivery Excellence department, working closely with Delivery Leads, Project Managers, Programme Managers, and other delivery roles.

Our global SAP S/4HANA business transformation programme has established the foundation, template and delivery experience required to transform and standardize core business processes across Pandora. Having successfully progressed through the initial rollout waves, we are now entering the next phase: scaling deployment across markets and business units globally. Our ambition is to make each subsequent rollout faster, more efficient and increasingly repeatable, leveraging a mature global template, standardized delivery approach and lessons learned from previous deployments. This position will be instrumental in driving this evolution, taking ownership of end-to-end rollout delivery while helping build a scalable, high-performing rollout capability that combines speed and efficiency with strong business outcomes, adoption and delivery quality.

We would like to hear from you if you are passionate about orchestrating complex deliveries, a strong delivery leader who can guide and influence teams, and an enabler who fosters alignment and collaboration. You bring a structured yet empowering approach, grounded in a servant-leadership mindset. You have solid experience in programme management and have previously worked in roles such as Programme Manager, Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar, ideally within an SAP ECC or S/4HANA transformation. You do not need to be the SAP solution expert, but you understand what it takes to lead one, and you know the right questions to ask and when to challenge. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with diverse stakeholders, where your communication, coordination, and relationship-building skills are essential to driving successful outcomes.

**In Your Role As Programme Manager You Will

**

• Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP S/4HANA rollouts, from mobilization and design through build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality while protecting business continuity.

• Drive rollout scale, speed and efficiency, applying standardized ways of working, lessons learned and continuous improvement to make successive deployments increasingly predictable, repeatable and efficient.

• Mobilize and lead cross-functional rollout teams, securing the right business and technology resources, establishing clear accountabilities, governance and ways of working, and creating strong collaboration across global and local teams.

• Own the integrated rollout plan and critical path, actively managing dependencies, resource constraints, risks, issues and competing initiatives, identifying potential bottlenecks early and driving timely resolution.

• Partner closely with business leaders and functional teams to ensure business requirements are understood, the global template is adopted effectively, and the organization is ready for the change.

• Provide strong delivery governance and executive transparency, establishing relevant performance metrics, facilitating Steering Committees, enabling timely decision-making and escalating material risks or issues when required.

• Orchestrate execution across design, build and testing, ensuring scope and design decisions are aligned with template standards, build activities progress to plan, and integration and user acceptance testing provide confidence in business and solution readiness.

• Lead cutover and go-live readiness, coordinating business cutover, data migration, dress rehearsals, readiness assessments, contingency planning and go/no-go decision-making to enable a controlled and successful launch.

• Lead the transition into hypercare and steady-state operations, ensuring system stability, rapid resolution of critical issues, effective knowledge transfer and clear criteria for hypercare exit.

• Manage the performance of system integration and delivery partners, setting clear expectations, monitoring delivery against commitments and proactively addressing or escalating performance challenges.

• Champion continuous improvement across the rollout portfolio, translating experience and lessons learned into simpler processes, stronger delivery practices and opportunities to accelerate future rollouts.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• Demonstrated experience leading complex programmes or large-scale transformations in a global organisation.

• Practical SAP S/4HANA programme experience, in a leadership role, covering stages from design and build through testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare

• Experience working with vendor-led delivery and SAP implementation partners.

• Strong coordination, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to turn complexity into concise, actionable messages.

• Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and driving challenging discussions and decisions.

• Comfortable working in matrixed, multi-team and international environments.

• A delivery mindset, taking ownership for outcomes and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**Service Desk Technician - Network

**Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

**About The Role And The Team

**You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

**What You’ll Be Working On
